name: LLM Models
description: Discover LLM providers and models on this venue, with CALLER-RELATIVE readiness. Returns {providers: [{op, provider, keySecret, ready, models, url?, note?}]}. 'ready' reflects whether YOUR secret store holds the provider's conventional key (the value is never returned) — or, for ollama, live server reachability with its installed model list. Hosted model lists are hints: conservative built-ins, operator-overridable via venue config adapters.langchain.models.<provider>.

provider.description: Optional filter: openai | anthropic | gemini | deepseek | xai | ollama

output.description: {providers: [{op, provider, keySecret, ready, models, url?, note?}]} — pick a ready provider; configure agents with llmOperation = op, apiKey = 's/<keySecret>'.
